newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chips fall in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chips fall in late trading.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks failed to build on Friday's record and gave back gains in late trading to end lower Monday.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average fell 11.54 points to close at 6,549.37 after trading higher for much of the session. The index of 30 blue-chip issues rose 14.23 points to a record 6,560.91 on Friday. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a narrow 13-11 margin on moderate volume of about 342 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
